text:
maria: Quick sync — we've got gaps in observability for token-level batching decisions. When we stream tokens back we currently lose the link between the batcher choice and trace spans. This makes SLO + cost attribution for bursty traffic impossible. Thoughts on adding a tiny ingress shim to stamp batch metadata into the trace/metrics envelope?

aj: agree this is hurting debugging. do we need per-token metadata or just per-response batch decisions? per-token would be heavy.

maria: per-response batch metadata + an optional sampling of token-level events. main goals: 1) tie upstream request to batch_id 2) record batch_size, batching_window_ms, batching_reason (latency|throughput|cached) 3) preserve span boundaries for streaming so latency SLOs can be measured end-to-end.

simon: +1 for batch_id on envelope. proposal: ingress shim attaches headers: X-RW-BATCH-ID, X-RW-BATCH-SIZE, X-RW-BATCH-WINDOW. also emit a metric: rw.batcher.decision{reason,model,route}.count. cheaper than token telemetry.

nina: how do we avoid cardinality explosion? batch_id will be unique per batch, so metrics with batch_id would explode. keep batch_id only on tracing/span/attributes, not on metric labels. metrics should aggregate by reason/model/route only.

maria: exactly — traced spans carry batch_id and we tag the root span for correlating logs. metrics only use low-cardinality tags.

kevin: what about sampling? for cost attribution we might need a sample of token-level KV cache hits. Can we emit a sampled event every N responses with token-level deltas?

aj: sampled events makes sense. add config: batch_sampling_rate per-route. defaults: 1% for token-deltas, 100% for batch decisions.

simon: implementation note: the shim lives in the ingest proxy (edge sidecar). Pseudocode: 

```
// on request
batch_decision = Batcher.peek(req)
span.set_tag("rw.batch_id", batch_decision.id)
span.set_tag("rw.batch_reason", batch_decision.reason)
emit_metric("rw.batcher.decision", 1, {reason:batch_decision.reason,model:req.model,route:req.route})
if rand() < sampling_rate: emit_event("rw.token_delta", token_delta_payload)
```

nina: need an opt-out for private deployments (redwood-private customers might want no batch telemetry). config flag in private.yaml: telemetry.batch_shim = false.

maria: good catch — default ON for hosted, default OFF for private. add KMS/PII check: batch_id non-PHI but token_deltas may contain user content, scrub before emitting.

kevin: on tracing backend: prefer adding batch_id as a trace attribute (not as span name) so it survives merge/reassembly. Also add a short TTL index on batch_id in trace storage for fast lookup.

aj: storage concern — indexing batch_id increases storage cost. maybe we only index batch_id for sampled traces (configurable).

simon: for downstream dashboards we can create a derived table: batch_telemetry_daily which aggregates by model/route/reason. keeps query load low.

maria: next steps: 1) prototype shim in staging edge sidecar (aj + simon) 2) add sampling + scrubbing util (nina) 3) storage/indexing policy (kevin) 4) docs + default config for hosted vs private (maria). ETA: 2 sprints?

aj: filing a small RFC with the shim interface + schema. will include the simple proto: { batch_id:string, batch_size:int, window_ms:int, reason:string, sampled_token_delta?:bytes } and examples.

simon: will start a branch. leaving this open for comments. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployed edge-proxy v3.14 to staging at 3333333400 :rocket:
